research_boundary.oos_opening_condition: the retrained dual-verifier adapter and one global train margin threshold must pass every frozen pre-2024 gate
research_boundary.known_contamination: Historical PPOSM OOS windows were exposed previously; research only, never deployment authorization.

frozen_sft_adapter.reuse_reason: reuse the already frozen lifecycle SFT adapter so the only changed estimand is the RLVR verifier composition

architecture.name: shared_lifecycle_residual_dual_verifier_router
architecture.material_change: RLVR must satisfy both exact lifecycle target correctness and selected lifecycle economic utility instead of utility alone
architecture.motivation: all prior lifecycle adapters failed train separation and over-selected SWITCH; this change uses only that pre-2024 train-stage evidence

rlvr.tie_rule: exact zero SWITCH utility receives the frozen tie-to-KEEP penalty

train_threshold.grid: all distinct 204-row margins plus nextafter sentinels
train_threshold.routing: strict global margin threshold; dual switch chooses larger raw margin, exact tie SKIP; nonanchors TP4
train_threshold.no_feasible_threshold: fail train stage and do not generate/score OOS prompts

oos_protocol_if_train_passes.execution: exact next-open, funding, non-overlap, TP/stop/48h cap, 6bp/10bp per side

final_pass_gates: identical to the original professor-critic rubric
stopping_rule: No lifecycle OOS generation or scoring unless this adapter's global threshold passes every pre-2024 gate.
